m: Pound or finely chop the garlic and chilli together.
Fry the garlic and chilli in a hot wok for 30 seconds. Add the mince and stir-fry hard, breaking it up, until browned and a little crispy.
Add the sliced beans, then the oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce and sugar. Toss 2 minutes.
Off the heat, stir through a big handful of Thai basil until it wilts.
Fry the eggs in plenty of hot oil until the edges are crispy and the yolk's still runny. Serve over rice.
l: Pork over rice. Skip the egg for lunch or pack a boiled one.
g: Tamari instead of soy and a GF oyster sauce, cooked in a separate wok. Check the fish sauce.
